story.title: Ecofy Raises $15M From Mirova to Expand Green Financing Portfolio Across India's Energy Transition
story.summary: Indian green fintech startup Ecofy has raised $15 million from Mirova, an affiliate of Natixis Investment Managers, to expand its portfolio of financing products for India's energy transition. The investment marks Mirova's fourth deal in India under its emerging markets climate mandate, underlining growing international confidence in Indian green finance infrastructure. Ecofy targets underserved segments of India's clean energy economy, including rooftop solar and energy-efficient consumer products, with AI-assisted credit underwriting.
use_cases: green loan products for Indian consumers
AI-assisted underwriting for energy transition financing
international climate capital deployment in India
